research.title: Preprocessing and Evaluation for Support Request Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned text normalization and label mapping routines for support request classification, following existing preprocessing specifications.
Ran prescribed classification evaluations and inspected confusion matrices, documenting mislabeled examples and recurring ambiguity between related request categories.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded inventory discrepancies, and routed missing item reports to the appropriate staff.
Updated order status records, organized shipping paperwork, and coordinated routine pickup arrangements using established office procedures.

projects.title: TF-IDF Baseline for Movie Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented a sentiment classification baseline using TF-IDF features and logistic regression, fitting the vocabulary only on training reviews.
Compared unigram and bigram feature settings on validation data, then reviewed test errors involving negation and mixed sentiment.
